subject: Housing Stability Notification Ordinance
overview: The committee reviewed and amended a proposed ordinance requiring landlords to provide tenants with information on housing rights and resources. The matter was reported out to the full City Council for further action.

items.title: Housing Stability Notification Ordinance Overview
items.summary: Councilor Collins provided an overview of the ordinance, which mandates that property owners distribute city-created housing rights documents at the inception and termination of tenancies.

items.title: Legal Counsel Review and Fine Structure
items.summary: The committee discussed legal feedback from KP Law regarding fine appropriation and lien enforcement, noting that the ordinance stands on strong legal ground as an educational tool.

items.title: Implementation and Translation Requirements
items.summary: Board of Health Director MaryAnn O'Connor discussed the 90-day implementation timeline and the process for creating translated resource materials.

items.title: Amendment and Referral to Full Council
items.summary: Approved an amendment to strike an unused definition of "property" and approved reporting the paper out to the full City Council.
